title: Single Cell RNA Sequencing Library Preparation and Sequencing
author: Franchesca Farris
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bffvjjn6
materials: iii.280 µl to unused wells in row labeled

steps.title: Prepare Single Cell Master Mix
steps.instruction: On ice, prepare the Master Mix, pipette‑mix 15 times, briefly centrifuge, then add 33.4 µL Master Mix to each tube of a PCR 8‑tube strip.

steps.title: Load Chromium Chip B
steps.instruction: Assemble Chip B in a 10x Chip Holder, add glycerol to unused wells, prepare Master Mix + Cell Suspension to 80 µL total, load rows 1‑3 with Master Mix, Gel Beads and Partitioning Oil, and attach the gasket without touching its surface.

substeps.instruction: Assemble Chromium Chip B in a 10x Chip Holder.
Dispense 75 µL 50 % glycerol to unused wells in row 1, 40 µL to row 2, and 280 µL to row 3.

Prepare Master Mix + Cell Suspension: add nuclease‑free water and the appropriate volume of single‑cell suspension (per Cell Suspension Volume Calculator) to reach 80 µL total per tube; gently pipette‑mix the suspension before adding to Master Mix.
Load Row 1: using the same tip, dispense 75 µL Master Mix + Cell Suspension against the side of each well in row 1.
Prepare Gel Beads: snap the Gel Bead strip into a 10x Vortex Adapter, vortex 30 s, flick downward to recover all beads, confirm no bubbles and even liquid levels.
Load Row 2: puncture foil seal of Gel Bead tubes, slowly aspirate 40 µL Gel Beads, dispense against the side of each well in row 2.
Load Row 3: dispense 280 µL Partitioning Oil against the side of each well in row 3 by pipetting two 140 µL aliquots from a reagent reservoir (do not omit oil).
Attach 10x gasket: align the notch with the top‑left corner, ensure gasket holes align with wells, avoid touching the smooth gasket surface and do NOT press down on the gasket.

steps.title: Run Chromium Controller
steps.instruction: Eject the tray, place the assembled chip with gasket into the tray, retract the tray, confirm the Chromium Single Cell B program, press play, and wait ~8.5 min for the run to complete (controller will chime).

steps.title: Transfer GEMs
steps.instruction: On ice, remove the chip, discard the gasket, open the holder, expose wells at 45°, aspirate 100 µL GEMs from the lowest points without sealing, dispense into a tube strip on ice over ~20 s, and keep on ice ≤1 h if multiple chips are processed.

substeps.instruction: Place a tube strip on ice.
Press the eject button of the Controller and remove the chip.
Discard the gasket, open the chip holder, fold the lid back until it clicks to expose wells at 45°; ensure partitioning oil does not spill.
Check volumes in rows 1‑3; high volume indicates a clog.
Slowly aspirate 100 µL GEMs from the lowest points of the Recovery Wells without creating a seal between tip and well bottom.
Withdraw tips; GEMs should appear opaque and uniform; clear oil in tips indicates a potential clog.
Dispense GEMs into the tube strip on ice against the tube sidewalls over ~20 s.
If running multiple chips, cap/cover the GEM‑containing strip and keep on ice for no more than 1 h.

steps.title: GEM‑RT Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the GEMs in a thermal cycler using the specified protocol; thereafter store at 4 °C for up to 72 h, at –20 °C for up to 1 week, or proceed directly to cleanup.

steps.title: Post GEM‑RT Cleanup – Dynabeads
steps.instruction: Add Recovery Agent, remove oil, bind Dynabeads, wash, and elute cDNA using magnetic separation as detailed.

substeps.instruction: Add 125 µL Recovery Agent to each sample at room temperature; do NOT pipette‑mix or vortex; wait 2 min.
Slowly remove and discard 125 µL pink Recovery Agent/Partitioning Oil from the tube bottom without aspirating aqueous sample.
Prepare Dynabeads Cleanup Mix; vortex and add 200 µL to each sample; pipette‑mix 10 times (set to 200 µL).
Incubate 10 min at room temperature; pipette‑mix again ~5 min after start to resuspend beads.
Prepare Elution Solution I (vortex and briefly centrifuge).
Place tubes on a 10× Magnetic Separator (High position) until solution clears; remove supernatant.
Add 300 µL 80 % ethanol to pellet while on magnet; wait 30 s; remove ethanol.
Add 200 µL 80 % ethanol; wait 30 s; remove ethanol.
Centrifuge briefly; place on magnet (Low); remove remaining ethanol; air‑dry 1 min.
Remove from magnet; add 35.5 µL Elution Solution I; pipette‑mix (set to 30 µL) without bubbles.
Incubate 2 min at room temperature; place on magnet (Low) until solution clears.
Transfer 35 µL eluate to a new tube strip.

steps.title: cDNA Amplification
steps.instruction: Prepare cDNA Amplification Mix on ice, add 65 µL mix to 35 µL sample, pipette‑mix, briefly centrifuge, and amplify in a thermal cycler using the specified program.

substeps.instruction: Prepare cDNA Amplification Mix on ice; vortex and briefly centrifuge.
Add 65 µL cDNA Amplification Reaction Mix to 35 µL sample.
Pipette‑mix 15 times (set to 90 µL); briefly centrifuge.
Incubate in a thermal cycler with the provided protocol.
Store at 4 °C for up to 72 h, at –20 °C for ≤1 week, or proceed.

steps.title: cDNA Cleanup – SPRIselect
steps.instruction: Perform 0.6× SPRIselect bead cleanup, two ethanol washes, elute in Buffer EB, and transfer purified cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Vortex SPRIselect reagent; add 60 µL (0.6×) to each sample; pipette‑mix 15 times (set to 150 µL).
Incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet (High) until solution clears; remove supernatant.
Add 200 µL 80 % ethanol to pellet; wait 30 s; remove ethanol.
Repeat ethanol wash for a total of two washes.
Centrifuge briefly; place on magnet (Low); remove remaining ethanol.
Air‑dry 2 min (do not exceed 2 min).
Remove from magnet; add 40.5 µL Buffer EB; pipette‑mix 15 times.
Incubate 2 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet (High) until solution clears.
Transfer 40 µL eluate to a new tube strip.
Store at 4 °C for up to 72 h, at –20 °C for up to 4 weeks, or proceed.

steps.title: cDNA QC & Quantification
steps.instruction: Run 1 µL of the cDNA sample (1:10 dilution) on an Agilent Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity chip.

steps.title: Fragmentation, End Repair & A‑Tailing
steps.instruction: Prepare fragmentation mix, combine with cDNA, mix on ice, and run the thermal cycler protocol.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a thermal cycler with the specified incubation protocol.
Vortex Fragmentation Buffer and verify no precipitate.
Prepare Fragmentation Mix on ice; vortex, mix and briefly centrifuge.
Transfer ONLY 10 µL purified cDNA (from cDNA Cleanup step) to a tube strip.
Add 25 µL Buffer EB to each sample.
Add 15 µL Fragmentation Mix to each sample.
Pipette‑mix 15 times (set to 35 µL) on ice; briefly centrifuge.
Transfer tubes to the pre‑cooled thermal cycler (4 °C) and press “SKIP” to start the protocol.

steps.title: Post‑Fragmentation Double‑Sided Size Selection
steps.instruction: Perform two‑step SPRIselect size selection (0.6× then 0.8×), ethanol washes, and elution in Buffer EB.

substeps.instruction: Vortex SPRIselect reagent; add 30 µL (0.6×) to each sample; pipette‑mix 15 times (set to 75 µL).
Incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet (High) until solution clears; DO NOT discard supernatant.
Transfer 75 µL supernatant to a new tube strip.
Vortex SPRIselect reagent; add 10 µL (0.8×) to each sample; pipette‑mix 15 times (set to 80 µL).
Incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet (High) until clears; remove 80 µL supernatant (DO NOT discard beads).
Add 125 µL 80 % ethanol to pellet; wait 30 s; remove ethanol.
Repeat ethanol wash for a total of two washes.
Centrifuge briefly; place on magnet (Low) until clears; remove remaining ethanol (DO NOT over‑dry).
Remove from magnet; add 50.5 µL Buffer EB; pipette‑mix 15 times.
Incubate 2 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet (High) until clears.
Transfer 50 µL eluate to a new tube strip.

steps.title: Adaptor Ligation
steps.instruction: Prepare Adaptor Ligation Mix, combine with sample, mix, and incubate in a thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Adaptor Ligation Mix; vortex and briefly centrifuge.
Add 50 µL Adaptor Ligation Mix to 50 µL sample.
Pipette‑mix 15 times (set to 90 µL); briefly centrifuge.
Incubate in a thermal cycler using the specified protocol.

steps.title: Post‑Ligation Cleanup – SPRIselect
steps.instruction: Perform 0.8× SPRIselect bead cleanup with two ethanol washes and elute in Buffer EB.

substeps.instruction: Vortex SPRIselect reagent; add 80 µL (0.8×) to each sample; pipette‑mix 15 times (set to 150 µL).
Incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet (High) until solution clears; remove supernatant.
Add 200 µL 80 % ethanol to pellet; wait 30 s; remove ethanol.
Repeat ethanol wash for a total of two washes.
Centrifuge briefly; place on magnet (Low).
Remove any remaining ethanol; air‑dry 2 min (do not exceed).
Remove from magnet; add 30.5 µL Buffer EB; pipette‑mix 15 times.
Incubate 2 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet (Low) until clears.
Transfer 30 µL eluate to a new tube strip.

steps.title: Sample Index PCR
steps.instruction: Add Sample Index PCR Mix and i7 index to each sample, amplify, and store as needed.

substeps.instruction: Choose appropriate 10x Sample Index sets (record PN‑220103 well ID) ensuring no overlap in multiplexed run.
Prepare Sample Index PCR Mix.
Add 60 µL Sample Index PCR Mix to 30 µL sample.
Add 10 µL individual Chromium i7 Sample Index to each well; record well ID.
Pipette‑mix 5 times (set to 90 µL); briefly centrifuge.
Incubate in a thermal cycler using the specified protocol.
Store at 4 °C for up to 72 h or proceed to cleanup.

steps.title: Post‑Sample Index PCR Double‑Sided Size Selection
steps.instruction: Perform two‑step SPRIselect size selection (0.6× then 0.8×) after index PCR, ethanol washes, and elution in Buffer EB.

substeps.instruction: Vortex SPRIselect reagent; add 60 µL (0.6×) to each sample; pipette‑mix 15 times (set to 150 µL).
Incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet (High) until clears; DO NOT discard supernatant.
Transfer 150 µL supernatant to a new tube strip.
Vortex SPRIselect reagent; add 20 µL (0.8×) to each sample; pipette‑mix 15 times (set to 150 µL).
Incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet (High) until clears; remove 165 µL supernatant (DO NOT discard beads).
With tube still on magnet, add 200 µL 80 % ethanol to pellet; wait 30 s; remove ethanol.
Repeat ethanol wash for a total of two washes.
Centrifuge briefly; place on magnet (Low).
Remove remaining ethanol.
Remove from magnet; add 35.5 µL Buffer EB; pipette‑mix 15 times.
Incubate 2 min at room temperature.
Place on magnet (Low) until clears.
Transfer 35 µL eluate to a new tube strip.
Store at 4 °C for up to 72 h or at –20 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Post‑Library Construction QC
steps.instruction: Run 1 µL of the final library (1:10 dilution) on an Agilent Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity chip and record the average fragment size for downstream quantification.

steps.title: Prepare Cryopreserved Cells for GEM Generation
steps.instruction: Thaw cryopreserved cells, wash three times in PBS 0.04 % BSA, filter, count viability, and proceed to encapsulation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 50 mL PBS with 0.04 % BSA; aliquot 9 mL into a 15 mL conical tube and keep on ice.
Transfer cell vial from liquid nitrogen to wet ice, then immediately to a 37 °C water bath.
Submerge cryovial above the fill line, agitate until fully liquid.
Transfer contents to the 15 mL conical tube containing PBS 0.04 % BSA; cap and gently invert to mix.
Centrifuge 350 g for 5 min at 8 °C; decant supernatant.
Resuspend pellet gently, add 10 mL cold PBS 0.04 % BSA; centrifuge 350 g 5 min at 8 °C; decant.
Repeat the wash step for a total of three washes.
Resuspend final pellet in 1 mL PBS 0.04 % BSA; strain through a Flowmi tip into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube on ice.
Take a 20 µL aliquot for counting on a Nexcelom Cellometer.
Add 20 µL Viastain AO/PI to the aliquot, mix, then add 20 µL to a counting slide; count using “immune cells low RBC” setting with dilution factor 2.0; record total yield and viability.
Verify cell viability > 80 % with minimal debris; proceed to 10x Genomics GEM generation.

steps.title: Prepare Libraries for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Calculate library molarity, dilute each library to an equimolar concentration, and pool them aiming for 50 000 reads per cell.

steps.title: Sequencing Recommendations
steps.instruction: Dilute the final library pool to 5 nM, quantify by qPCR, and sequence on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 (loading concentration 170 pM, 1 % PhiX spike‑in) following the manufacturer’s guidelines.
